parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: ID of the user. `me` is also accepted for the signed-in user

200.description: true when the sessions were ended

description:
Ends every session of a user at once, on every device. API tokens keep working: revoke them separately. For your own account the answer also clears your session cookie.

Needs: a signed-in session as that user or as an administrator (API tokens are refused)
